messages.text: Map the chain from a Aerospace / Defense market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester.

已查到可引用的部分資料：

One-line recommendation: No passage directly supports an Aerospace / Defense market-requirement → measurable-parameter → Signaling / Non-signaling tester-capability chain; the A&D source is only listed as an un-ingested external link, so the chain below is only an adjacent technical mapping from supported wireless / satellite regulatory and tester evidence [9][15].
### Recommended first sell
The closest supported entry points are regulatory / satellite-terminal style testing, because the passages list mobile satellite / mobile earth station measurable items such as RF output power, occupied bandwidth, emission masks, unwanted emissions, carrier-off emissions, and frequency stability [12], and they separately identify wireless communication testers, signal & spectrum analyzers, vector signal generators, and related instruments as primary regulatory-lab instruments [12].
### Product and capability mapping
| Product line | Market / requirement facet supported by passages | Measurable parameter | Required Signaling / Non-signaling tester capability | Evidence | Gap / risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 / CMW500 signaling tester | 5G NR SAR testing requires a 5G NR network emulator to drive the EUT to extreme transmission conditions, and multi-radio UE average-SAR testing needs flexible signaling across cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth [5]. | Extreme transmission condition; SAR / HAC context [5]. | Network-emulation and signaling capability; CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [8]. | [5][8] | Not proven to be an Aerospace / Defense requirement. |
| R&S CMX500 signaling tester | EMC testing requires radio-enabled and radio-disabled conditions, so 5G NR EMC testing needs a signaling solution [5]. | Radio-enabled / radio-disabled EMC conditions; Audio Breakthrough for mobile phones from GSM to VoLTE / VoNR by 5G [5]. | 5G NR signaling plus application / IMS / audio / POLQA support; CMX500 provides LTE / NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, plus application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS / audio / POLQA [8]. | [5][8] | EMC requirement is supported for wireless devices, not specifically A&D. |
| R&S CMX500 Callbox | Callbox use cases include R&D verification of new bands, sensitivity testing, 3GPP pre-conformance, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification [7]. | Sensitivity; throughput; 3GPP pre-conformance; non-signaling verification [7]. | Easy DUT connection and RF / mobility / application / NTN / WLAN-cellular desense / pre-conformance / non-signaling R&D verification [13]; easy setup, easy call establishment, and RF testing including 3GPP pre-conformance [20]. | [7][13][20] | Not directly tied to an Aerospace / Defense market requirement. |
| R&S CMX500 for radio-performance measurements | CMX500 supports NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [8]. | TX measurements; BLER; CSI report; throughput; PER [8]. | Combined signaling and measurement functions for cellular and WLAN device testing [8]. | [8] | Option codes / orderable configurations are not identified in the passages. |
| R&S CMP180 non-signaling tester | Wi-Fi 7 R&D / production testing positions CMX500 for R&D signaling / interworking and CMP180 for production non-signaling RF testing [24]. | Production RF test; transmitter-side RF paths are supported by 8 input signals multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 1 and 8 input signals multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 2 [14]. | Non-signaling production RF test with multiplexed RF analyzer inputs and frequency-dependent attenuation correction tables [14][24]. | [14][24] | Wi-Fi 7 production is supported, but Aerospace / Defense linkage is not. |
| Regulatory satellite / mobile earth station test setup | FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station test items are listed [12]. | RF output power, occupied bandwidth, emission mask within 25% of authorized bandwidth, out-of-band emissions, unwanted emissions at 1559–1610 MHz, carrier-off emissions at 1559–1610 MHz, and frequency stability [12]. | Primary instrument classes for wireless regulatory labs include wireless communication tester, EMI test receiver, signal & spectrum analyzer, network analyzer, vector signal generator, and broadband amplifier [12]. | [12] | Passage does not name a specific Signaling / Non-signaling tester model for these FCC §25 items. |
### Scenario chain candidates
| Scenario | Chain from requirement to parameter to tester capability | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 5G device SAR / HAC | Market-access style wireless compliance → EUT driven to extreme transmission condition → 5G NR network emulator / flexible signaling using CMW500 or CMX500 signaling solution [5]. | Supported for wireless compliance, not A&D-specific. |
| 5G EMC | EMC requirement with radio enabled and disabled → signaling required for 5G NR conditions → CMX500-powered EMC systems and CMX500 signaling / measurement capabilities [19][8]. | Supported for CE RED EMC context, not A&D-specific. |
| Satellite / mobile earth station regulatory testing | Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station regulatory items → RF output power, occupied bandwidth, emission mask, OOB / unwanted / carrier-off emissions, frequency stability → regulatory lab instruments such as wireless communication tester and signal & spectrum analyzer [12]. | Supported technically, but no direct A&D sales requirement or named tester configuration. |
【推論】If the Aerospace / Defense opportunity is a satellite-terminal or mobile-earth-station case, the measurable-parameter side should start from FCC §25-style RF output power, occupied bandwidth, emission, and frequency-stability tests, because those are the supported satellite / mobile earth station parameters in the passages [12].
【推論】If the Aerospace / Defense opportunity involves 5G-capable equipment rather than pure satellite RF, CMX500 is the best-supported signaling tester candidate because the passages support 5G NR network emulation, LTE / NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling, TX measurements, BLER, throughput, PER, and application / IMS / audio testing [5][8].
【推論】If the opportunity is production RF rather than R&D signaling, CMP180 is the best-supported non-signaling candidate in the passages because it is explicitly positioned for production non-signaling RF testing and has multiplexed RF analyzer input capabilities [24][14].
### Limits
The passages do not provide a verified Aerospace / Defense market requirement, customer problem statement, procurement driver, option code, price, orderable configuration, or direct A&D-to-tester recommendation; the only A&D-related source is listed as an external PARPRO aerospace & defense link whose webpage text was not ingested [9][15].

passages.text:
Space Supply Chain › 與既有知識的關係
- 與 [[4. Satellite Eco-chain in Taiwan]] 類似，本來源主要是 satellite / space supply chain link hub；兩者都含未擷取外部資料與未 OCR 圖片，不可直接當成已驗證供應鏈證據。
- 與 [[3. Satcom market summary]] 類似，本來源列出外部新聞與文章連結；在正文未擷取前，只能作為待讀索引。
- 與 [[0.Satcom Industry]]、[[台灣太空產業]]、[[台灣太空產業地圖]]、[[通訊衛星製造產業平台]]相關，但本來源沒有提供可直接增補的台灣太空產業地圖版本、公司名單、分類規則或政策資料。
- 與 [[低軌衛星零組件與地面終端供應鏈]]相關，但 Yahoo 連結標題中的 [[事欣科]] / AST 訂單說法尚未取得正文或公告，不更新該供應鏈表格。

事欣科
[[事欣科]]是 [[Space Supply Chain]] 中 Yahoo 股市文章連結標題括號內出現的公司名稱；本 vault 目前尚未擷取該新聞正文或公司公告。

Juergen Meyer
[[Juergen Meyer]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]] 中列名的 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive。

VIAVI O-RU Tester › 不可推論的內容
- 來源未提供 VIAVI O-RU Tester 或 VIAVI TM500 O-RU Tester 的正式產品名稱、料號、software release、supported O-RAN WG4 spec versions、license 或 interface option。
- 來源未提供 VIAVI 官方 datasheet / application note；不可由 R&S 簡報推論 VIAVI product roadmap、formal specification 或 market share。
- 來源未提供 T-BC、FTN、PTP-GM、O-RU TMA、interconnection unit、TMA / TM500 software library 的具體版本與 timing architecture。
- March 2025 來源中的 price point、competitor comparison、test case counts 與 VAR commercial terms 屬 internal / market context，需依正式 quote、contract、software release notes 與 public material 補證。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

passages.text:
R&S CMW500 › 支援技術摘要
- [[R&S CMW500]] 在 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] 中是唯一明確支援 GSM small cell、WCDMA small cell、LTE small cell 的 CMW 型號。
- GSM、NB-IoT、WCDMA、LTE mobile station test 與 NR Sub-6GHz 章節明確標示適用於 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW290]]。
- Four RF paths、DAU B450H/I、Digital I/Q 1 to 4 / 5 to 8、Digital I/Q QUAD 章節明確標示 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW270]]。
- Bluetooth standard：Bluetooth Core Specification Version 5.0；test standard 包含 RF.TS.5.0.0 與 RF-PHY.TS.5.0.0。
- WLAN 160 MHz bandwidth unit 章節列出 IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n/ac 與 IEEE 802.11ax，bandwidth up to 160 MHz。
- [[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 補充 [[NGeCall over LTE]]、[[IMS eCall]]、[[IVS]]、[[PSAP]]、[[MSD]]、limited service、callback、clear-down、SRVCC handover 等 eCall 測試語境。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Space Supply Chain
這份 OneNote 來源是 space / satellite supply chain 的外部資料與圖片 link hub，列出 [[Satellite Applications Catapult]] 的 Space Capabilities Catalogue、Yahoo 股市文章連結、[[PARPRO]] aerospace & defense solution 連結，以及多張未 OCR 圖片；本次 ingest 未擷取外部網頁正文，也未擷取圖片文字。

Juergen Meyer › 來源中的列名
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 人名：Juergen Meyer。
- 組織：[[Rohde & Schwarz]]。
- 職稱：Vice President Market Segment Automotive at Rohde & Schwarz。
- 引言主旨：他表示 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 很高興與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作驗證其 chipsets 的 NG eCall implementation，並稱此 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 設定 new benchmark，為 automotive industry 提供 robust and dependable solution 以 meet latest eCall standards。

NEC › unresolved
- 需要擷取 NEC Technical Journal 文章正文以確認日期、技術範圍、圖表與可引用主張。
- 需要判定該文章應歸入 [[Knowledge]] 技術背景、[[Productions]] 產品 / 模組資料，或 [[Market]] 市場線索。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[EN 303 981]] 測試描述為 antenna characterizations 的 radiated measurement，列出 antenna beam pointing、off/on-axis spurious radiation、carrier suppression / cessation、blocking performance、adjacent signal selectivity、image frequency rejection、WBES location / identification、control and monitoring functions、receive antenna off-axis gain pattern，並連到 [[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S ELEKTRA]]、[[R&S TS8996]]。
- 來源列出 FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station test items：RF output power、occupied bandwidth、emission mask within 25% of authorized BW、out of band emissions、additional unwanted emission 1559–1610 MHz、carrier-off state emissions 1559–1610 MHz、frequency stability，並提到 ANSI C63.26 / FCC KDBs。
- 最後來源把 primary test instruments for wireless regulatory test labs 分成 wireless communication tester、EMI test receiver、signal & spectrum analyzer、network analyzer、vector signal generator、broadband amplifier 等類別。

answer.text:
One-line recommendation: No passage directly supports an Aerospace / Defense market-requirement → measurable-parameter → Signaling / Non-signaling tester-capability chain; the A&D source is only listed as an un-ingested external link, so the chain below is only an adjacent technical mapping from supported wireless / satellite regulatory and tester evidence [9][15].
### Recommended first sell
The closest supported entry points are regulatory / satellite-terminal style testing, because the passages list mobile satellite / mobile earth station measurable items such as RF output power, occupied bandwidth, emission masks, unwanted emissions, carrier-off emissions, and frequency stability [12], and they separately identify wireless communication testers, signal & spectrum analyzers, vector signal generators, and related instruments as primary regulatory-lab instruments [12].
### Product and capability mapping
| Product line | Market / requirement facet supported by passages | Measurable parameter | Required Signaling / Non-signaling tester capability | Evidence | Gap / risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 / CMW500 signaling tester | 5G NR SAR testing requires a 5G NR network emulator to drive the EUT to extreme transmission conditions, and multi-radio UE average-SAR testing needs flexible signaling across cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth [5]. | Extreme transmission condition; SAR / HAC context [5]. | Network-emulation and signaling capability; CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [8]. | [5][8] | Not proven to be an Aerospace / Defense requirement. |
| R&S CMX500 signaling tester | EMC testing requires radio-enabled and radio-disabled conditions, so 5G NR EMC testing needs a signaling solution [5]. | Radio-enabled / radio-disabled EMC conditions; Audio Breakthrough for mobile phones from GSM to VoLTE / VoNR by 5G [5]. | 5G NR signaling plus application / IMS / audio / POLQA support; CMX500 provides LTE / NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, plus application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS / audio / POLQA [8]. | [5][8] | EMC requirement is supported for wireless devices, not specifically A&D. |
| R&S CMX500 Callbox | Callbox use cases include R&D verification of new bands, sensitivity testing, 3GPP pre-conformance, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification [7]. | Sensitivity; throughput; 3GPP pre-conformance; non-signaling verification [7]. | Easy DUT connection and RF / mobility / application / NTN / WLAN-cellular desense / pre-conformance / non-signaling R&D verification [13]; easy setup, easy call establishment, and RF testing including 3GPP pre-conformance [20]. | [7][13][20] | Not directly tied to an Aerospace / Defense market requirement. |
| R&S CMX500 for radio-performance measurements | CMX500 supports NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [8]. | TX measurements; BLER; CSI report; throughput; PER [8]. | Combined signaling and measurement functions for cellular and WLAN device testing [8]. | [8] | Option codes / orderable configurations are not identified in the passages. |
| R&S CMP180 non-signaling tester | Wi-Fi 7 R&D / production testing positions CMX500 for R&D signaling / interworking and CMP180 for production non-signaling RF testing [24]. | Production RF test; transmitter-side RF paths are supported by 8 input signals multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 1 and 8 input signals multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 2 [14]. | Non-signaling production RF test with multiplexed RF analyzer inputs and frequency-dependent attenuation correction tables [14][24]. | [14][24] | Wi-Fi 7 production is supported, but Aerospace / Defense linkage is not. |
| Regulatory satellite / mobile earth station test setup | FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station test items are listed [12]. | RF output power, occupied bandwidth, emission mask within 25% of authorized bandwidth, out-of-band emissions, unwanted emissions at 1559–1610 MHz, carrier-off emissions at 1559–1610 MHz, and frequency stability [12]. | Primary instrument classes for wireless regulatory labs include wireless communication tester, EMI test receiver, signal & spectrum analyzer, network analyzer, vector signal generator, and broadband amplifier [12]. | [12] | Passage does not name a specific Signaling / Non-signaling tester model for these FCC §25 items. |
### Scenario chain candidates
| Scenario | Chain from requirement to parameter to tester capability | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 5G device SAR / HAC | Market-access style wireless compliance → EUT driven to extreme transmission condition → 5G NR network emulator / flexible signaling using CMW500 or CMX500 signaling solution [5]. | Supported for wireless compliance, not A&D-specific. |
| 5G EMC | EMC requirement with radio enabled and disabled → signaling required for 5G NR conditions → CMX500-powered EMC systems and CMX500 signaling / measurement capabilities [19][8]. | Supported for CE RED EMC context, not A&D-specific. |
| Satellite / mobile earth station regulatory testing | Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station regulatory items → RF output power, occupied bandwidth, emission mask, OOB / unwanted / carrier-off emissions, frequency stability → regulatory lab instruments such as wireless communication tester and signal & spectrum analyzer [12]. | Supported technically, but no direct A&D sales requirement or named tester configuration. |
【推論】If the Aerospace / Defense opportunity is a satellite-terminal or mobile-earth-station case, the measurable-parameter side should start from FCC §25-style RF output power, occupied bandwidth, emission, and frequency-stability tests, because those are the supported satellite / mobile earth station parameters in the passages [12].
【推論】If the Aerospace / Defense opportunity involves 5G-capable equipment rather than pure satellite RF, CMX500 is the best-supported signaling tester candidate because the passages support 5G NR network emulation, LTE / NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling, TX measurements, BLER, throughput, PER, and application / IMS / audio testing [5][8].
【推論】If the opportunity is production RF rather than R&D signaling, CMP180 is the best-supported non-signaling candidate in the passages because it is explicitly positioned for production non-signaling RF testing and has multiplexed RF analyzer input capabilities [24][14].
### Limits
The passages do not provide a verified Aerospace / Defense market requirement, customer problem statement, procurement driver, option code, price, orderable configuration, or direct A&D-to-tester recommendation; the only A&D-related source is listed as an external PARPRO aerospace & defense link whose webpage text was not ingested [9][15].

cited_passages.text:
Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Space Supply Chain
這份 OneNote 來源是 space / satellite supply chain 的外部資料與圖片 link hub，列出 [[Satellite Applications Catapult]] 的 Space Capabilities Catalogue、Yahoo 股市文章連結、[[PARPRO]] aerospace & defense solution 連結，以及多張未 OCR 圖片；本次 ingest 未擷取外部網頁正文，也未擷取圖片文字。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[EN 303 981]] 測試描述為 antenna characterizations 的 radiated measurement，列出 antenna beam pointing、off/on-axis spurious radiation、carrier suppression / cessation、blocking performance、adjacent signal selectivity、image frequency rejection、WBES location / identification、control and monitoring functions、receive antenna off-axis gain pattern，並連到 [[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S ELEKTRA]]、[[R&S TS8996]]。
- 來源列出 FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station test items：RF output power、occupied bandwidth、emission mask within 25% of authorized BW、out of band emissions、additional unwanted emission 1559–1610 MHz、carrier-off state emissions 1559–1610 MHz、frequency stability，並提到 ANSI C63.26 / FCC KDBs。
- 最後來源把 primary test instruments for wireless regulatory test labs 分成 wireless communication tester、EMI test receiver、signal & spectrum analyzer、network analyzer、vector signal generator、broadband amplifier 等類別。
